name: Terrain Drainage, Puddle Geometry & Water Flow Runtime
design_rules: water follows slope before forming standing puddles
depressions retain more water than convex ground
stone and CIV-00 produce more runoff than soil
North Woodland keeps more shallow standing water after rain
Ring Basin drains quickly under exposed wind and open terrain
puddle geometry remains shallow and grounded
water flow is environmental simulation, not a navigation decal
water never uses emissive or glow feedback
